waivers.verdict: Nothing to claim this week. Juwan Johnson (bench TE) was ruled Out, but he's buried behind Bowers and Gesicki, so it doesn't open a hole. Everything else on the wire is still a pass.

lineup.verdict: Hold the lineup as set. Juwan Johnson (bench TE) was ruled Out, but he was never in the lineup, so nothing changes.

trades.verdict: Hold. The trade deadline (Week 11) passed last week — no trade can be made for the rest of the season.

inactives.verdict: Not actionable beyond today's Black Friday game, which is already locked. Jaylen Warren and the Denver defense kicked off healthy and in the lineup; nothing to pivot. The rest of the slate kicks off Sunday, and that's when the real inactives check runs.
